left.raw_text: - Participating PICUs must be a separate physical space dedicated to the care of critically ill infants and children, with the ability to provide mechanical ventilation.

right.raw_text: and would commit to not implementing a mobility protocol until the randomized time of unit implementation.

left.raw_text: All patients admitted to the PICUs regardless of length of stay will receive the unit-based PICU Up! intervention, which includes criteria for no mobilization based on specific clinical factors (i.e. open chest, surgeon request).

right.raw_text: For inclusion in data analysis, patients will be eligible if
Admitted to the participating PICU ≥ 3 days.
